capacity.policy: latest generation wins independently for each source

ownership.producer: client tick freezes scalar source/listener coordinates and a complete immutable scene snapshot
ownership.worker: owns one reusable LocalPlaneSceneSolver workspace and never reads ClientLevel, BlockState, VoxelShape, OpenAL, PCM or renderer state
ownership.consumer: applies only a published result whose source id and generation match the latest requested generation
ownership.result: fixed-capacity primitive DTO with at most six selected paths and six clusters

fallback.incomplete_snapshot: publish no explicit early paths and request direct plus conservative late fallback
fallback.worker_unavailable: retain prior smoothed render state; do not block the audio thread
